prose-content dark:prose-invert max-w-none pt-4 pb-0"> <p>Ask ChatGPT to generate or edit images. Use image generation for UI assets,
banners, backgrounds, illustrations, sprite sheets, and placeholders you want
to create alongside code or in a ChatGPT chat.</p>
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-id="app" data-ids="[&quot;app&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface"> <p>Ask for an image from the app composer. Add a reference image when you want
ChatGPT to transform an existing asset or use it as visual guidance.</p><h3 id="review-and-edit-generated-images" class="group flex items-center gap-1 mt-7 mb-2 scroll-mt-[110px]"><span Switch between
<strong>Focused view</strong> to inspect one image and <strong>Canvas view</strong> to see the images
generated in the same chat.</p><p>In <strong>Canvas view</strong>, use <strong>Comment</strong> to add precise feedback to one or more
images. Select <strong>Multi-select</strong> to choose the images you want to include, then
send your comments and any additional editing instructions in the same chat.
Describe what should change and what should remain the same.</p> </div> 
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-id="web" data-ids="[&quot;web&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface" data-markdown-ignore hidden> <p>Ask for an image in a ChatGPT web chat. Attach a reference image to the
composer when you want ChatGPT to edit it or use it as visual guidance.</p> </div> 
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-id="cli" data-ids="[&quot;cli&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface" data-markdown-ignore hidden> <p>Describe the image in an interactive session or include <code>$imagegen</code> to invoke
the image generation skill explicitly. Attach an existing image with <code>-i</code> or
<code>--image</code> when it should guide the result.</p> </div> 
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-id="ide" data-ids="[&quot;ide&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface" data-markdown-ignore hidden> <p>Ask for an image from the extension chat. Drag a reference image into
the composer while holding <kbd>Shift</kbd> when Codex should edit or build on
an existing asset.</p> </div>

9.29289C5.68341 8.90236 6.31658 8.90236 6.7071 9.29289Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></button></h2>
<p>Describe the image in natural language. Add a reference image when you want
ChatGPT to transform or extend an existing asset.</p>
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-ids="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface"> <p>Include <code>$imagegen</code> in your prompt to invoke the image generation skill
explicitly.</p><p>Built-in image generation uses <code>gpt-image-2</code> and counts toward your general
Codex usage limits. Image generations use included limits 3–5x faster on
average than similar turns without image generation, depending on image quality
and size. For larger batches, set <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code> in your environment and ask
ChatGPT to generate images through the API so API pricing applies.</p> </div> 
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-id="web" data-ids="[&quot;web&quot;]" data-default="app" data-choices="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;,&quot;cli&quot;,&quot;ide&quot;]" data-query-param="surface" data-markdown-ignore hidden> <p>Image availability and usage limits in ChatGPT web depend on your plan and
workspace settings. For programmatic image generation, use the <a href="/api/docs/guides/image-generation">Image
generation API</a>.</p> </div> 
<div class="content-mode-switch" data-content-mode-switch data-group="codex-surface" data-ids="[&quot;app&quot;,&quot;web&quot;]" data-default="app" 6.31658 8.90236 6.7071 9.29289Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></button></h2><p>A useful image prompt is often only one to three clear sentences. Describe the
details that determine whether the result succeeds:</p><ul>
<li>Explain the image’s purpose or intended audience.</li>
<li>Name the main subject and what is happening.</li>
<li>Describe the setting, composition, and visual style.</li>
<li>Add framing, dimensions, lighting, colors, or materials when they matter.</li>
<li>State constraints, including anything the image must not contain.</li>
</ul><p>Prefer concrete visual language over broad reactions. For example, describe
where light comes from instead of asking for “beautiful lighting.” Repeat any
requirement that must stay fixed.</p><div class="not-prose my-6" data-astro-cid-gablthhq> <div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-primary-surface bg-surface shadow-[0_10px_28px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)] dark:shadow-[0_16px_36px_rgba(0,0,0,0.28)]" data-astro-cid-gablthhq> <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-primary-surface px-6 py-3" data-astro-cid-gablthhq> <span class="text-sm font-medium text-secondary" data-astro-cid-gablthhq>Example prompt</span> <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2" data-astro-cid-gablthhq>  <astro-island uid="ZPdTxO" prefix="r32" component-url="/_astro/CopyButton.react.YaXtMe50.js?dpl=dpl_7iHSYrJ5jPyHvJgcWEVxZrsjhkmE" component-export="default" renderer-url="/_astro/client.CrYBL8V7.js?dpl=dpl_7iHSYrJ5jPyHvJgcWEVxZrsjhkmE" props="{&quot;copyValue&quot;:[0,&quot;Create a clean editorial illustration for an employee onboarding guide. <li><strong>Use likenesses with care.</strong> When depicting a real person, provide a
reference photo when appropriate and confirm that you have permission to use
their likeness.</li>
<li><strong>Ask for an original treatment.</strong> Request a generic or original design
instead of imitating a specific brand, product, artist, or artwork.</li>
<li><strong>Credit is optional.</strong> You do not need to credit OpenAI for generated images,
though you can explain how an asset was made when that context is useful.</li>
<li><strong>Follow applicable policies.</strong> Use images in accordance with your
organization’s guidelines and <a href="https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies/">OpenAI’s usage
policies</a>.</li>
</ul> </div>
